headline: Floor Boss: fast thumbs no longer lose their take
lede: Slot b's never-dry stage went after the shelf's weakest game and shipped a recording-honesty fix a two-thumb player can feel: same-frame taps used to corrupt the take; they now drain row by row, live matching replay. The hunt also dug up a dead tap — contract cards never worked.

notes.text: #2966 shipped (PR #2970, main d5eac2f, prod-verified): a solo tap still lands at click time, but a tap that finds the bank busy now rides its own row — the loop drain applies it where it banks. Two thumbs inside one frame keep their take instead of it refusing on the hash.

Harvest bug: clickOrder referenced its own initializer — EVERY contract-card tap was a silent ReferenceError, dead prio, dead event. Fixed and regression-pinned open/shipped/expired; a real finger lights the priority bit in the browser gate.

Proof: seed-7 OLD shape refuses exactly at checkpoint 300 through the adapter, NEW shape replays clean; mutant --mutate-taps dies by name; datasetcheck 66/66; lint x3 + build green. Play-suite rig legs are machine-load flaky across ALL branches tonight (untouched baseline fails the same families) — advisory per rule 3.
Board after: game-queue empty; R-TYPE held by QA (#2952), FloorBoss polish pass filed for QA (#2964); slot a shipped the Contra adapter (#2969) in parallel.
